originals.ko: 나는 마치 내가 거의 준비가 된 것처럼 느껴 왜냐하면 나는 많이 배웠거든
originals.why: This is natural Welsh, but the line has 'fel taswn i bron yn barod', which uses the earlier LEGO 'fel taswn i' (마치 내가 ~인 것처럼). It never contains 'fel taswn i’n', so as a USE row for this LEGO it doesn't practise the LEGO.
